5807.title: MCP bypasses the runtime-pinned CLI launcher
5807.rootCauseOneLine: MCP prefers the Node-shebang BB_CLI and ignores BB_CLI_LAUNCHER; without node on PATH the process exits 127 and command-index loading masks the error.
5807.proposedFix: Repair runtime availability at the service/server launch boundary for all plugins; using the existing runtime-pinned launcher is an MCP-specific mitigation.
5807.caveats: Two clean Linux checkouts exercise the real CLI and production MCP runner with an isolated PATH. macOS launchd, npm installation, server move, and Talk to BB were not exercised. No PR: the complete repair touches service packaging, excluded by the simple-fix rule. The reproduction script and output are inline in the report.
